WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ab.translink,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) AS matched_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
),
counts_with_fraction AS (
  SELECT
    translink,
    ordertypedist,
    matched_count,
    matched_count::numeric / SUM(matched_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction_of_mix_total
  FROM combination_counts
)
SELECT
  translink,
  ordertypedist,
  matched_count,
  fraction_of_mix_total
FROM counts_with_fraction
ORDER BY fraction_of_mix_total DESC
LIMIT 10;
